source_paragraphs.text: Abastado estar de qualquer cousa. — Xerecemõ, vel Xepoecemõ, tal ou tal cousa.
Abastar, ou abastado estar assi sobeiamente — O mesmo com iepe no cabo, ut xerecemõ iepe itaiuba .i. tenho dinheiro de sobeio.

targets.note: esemõ homonym 1 contains the provision/abundance senses and the money example.
targets.evidence_excerpt: Xe resemõ îepé itaîuba. - Sobra-me dinheiro, certamente.

targets.note: poesemõ contains fill/stock semantics and cross-refers to esemõ; cited to VLB I 17.
îepé homonym 6 repeats the money example.
targets.evidence_excerpt: Xe resemõ îepé itaîuba. - Sobra-me dinheiro, certamente.

cases.finding: Three successive Portuguese entries spread across two lexical heads and a particle entry. Source instructions about adding iepe should be preserved separately from the modern interpretation of that particle.
cases.recommended_action: Link lexical forms and examples separately; keep the source usage statement available for review.
unresolved: Do not infer that all grammatical interpretation is resolved merely because the words and example are present.

source_paragraphs.text: Abater hũas resoens cõ outras. — Aiapigpigc, vel, Aiapigpigc iepe, quer se refira âs mesmas resões, quer ao que as diz, mas tambem dizemos. Ainheengapigpigc iepe. act.

targets.note: apypyk sense 2 covers argumentation and gives the compound example.
targets.evidence_excerpt: Aînhe'engapypyk îepé. - Argumentei contra suas palavras, em vão.

targets.note: îepé homonym 6 has the identical Tupi example but translates the particle differently.

cases.finding: The current JSON renders the same sentence and VLB I 17 citation with em vão under apypyk and com efeito under îepé⁶. This is an internal inconsistency requiring verification, not grounds for silently choosing a translation.
cases.recommended_action: Check the relevant printed Navarro entries and VLB paragraph; record a correction proposal separately from source matching.

source_paragraphs.text: Abelha, gnlr. — Eiruba, tem muitas especies. Ybiraigpig. jateî. Eiruçu. Eirapua.

targets.note: VLB says Abelha, gnlr. and lists Eiruba; Navarro labels eiruba a species of bee.
Ybiraigpig corresponds to ybyraypy.
jateî corresponds to îate'i.
Eiruçu corresponds to eirusu.
Eirapua corresponds to eirapu'a.

cases.finding: All five named forms have dictionary targets, but the source explicitly presents Eiruba as general while the modern entry calls it a species. Lemma matching alone would conceal a semantic scope question.
cases.recommended_action: Preserve the general-versus-specific distinction for editorial review and link all four enumerated varieties.
unresolved: No claim is made that modern zoological identifications in Navarro are refuted by this paragraph alone.

source_paragraphs.text: Abil ser de mão. — Xepocarugoar, Xepocarugoacatu.

targets.note: Xepocarugoar corresponds to Xe pokarugûar, recorded under nominal headword pokarugûara.
Contains a pokarugûá-katu sequence in a compound about words; this does not directly cover the hand-skill source variant.

cases.finding: The base form is present; the additional Xepocarugoacatu source variant deserves an attestation link and morphological analysis rather than an automatically separate verbete.
cases.recommended_action: Record the source variant under the base after normalization review; do not substitute the speech compound as equivalent evidence.

source_paragraphs.text: Abortar por nascer assi de aborto. — Xeaquîrar.

targets.note: akyrara gives abortive and a mother/child-aborting example, but does not explicitly give Xeakyrar with the subject being the one born through abortion.
Related birth-event noun does not itself attest the participant frame of Xeaquîrar.

cases.finding: The lexical family exists. The VLB distinction between a mother aborting (line 44) and the aborted offspring as subject (line 45) is not explicitly illustrated in this JSON. This is a possible usage-frame/attestation addition, not yet a proven missing sense.
cases.recommended_action: Review predication and participant structure against VLB/print; add the source usage under the existing lexical family if warranted.
unresolved: The adjective abortivo may already license the reading compositionally; editorial choice determines whether to add a separate sense or usage note.
